items.reviewNote: The toothpick end is long, thin and pointed, not textile with threads unravelled. No French effiler family or earlier plan exists. All four masculine singular descriptions fit il est; only tapering to a point satisfies the clue.

Venait donner auprès describes the tip reaching towards a location. The global venir family includes spatial movement/origin; preserve sns_venir_primary for this positional extension, not recent past venir de or success venir à bout. No tense-only sense is added.

The subject is the pointed end and auprès du vaisseau supplies a spatial terminus. Donner is intransitive here: no gift, recipient, blow, event or pardon. Académie 1762 attests intransitive donner for touching/reaching; the non-impact positional reach here is an explicit contextual inference from the end and auprès complement, rather than a verbatim dictionary equivalence; prepare a fresh sense on the existing donner lemma and retain legacy giving mastery.

items.meaning: knees; lap formed by the knees
items.reviewNote: Sur ses genoux locates the dwarf on the giant’s lap. The body-part knee sense explains that position without a separate lap-only meaning. Genoux/coudes/talons/poignets are masculine plural and all fit les; the location between thigh and lower leg selects knees.

The head is the direct object lowered. Earlier baisser plans lower the body reflexively; this source lowers the head as a direct object. Both express the same downward lowering, so reuse the earlier planned sense and lemma rather than making a transitivity-only duplicate. The four verbs fit la; downwards movement alone selects baissait.

Moyennant introduces the effective means enabling speech, not a financial payment or negotiated condition. No published or earlier family exists. The four prepositions fit ces précautions, while the explicit beneficial-means clue selects moyennant.

These precautions avoid deafening the humans and make quiet speech possible. Précautions/distractions/célébrations/réclamations are feminine plural with des; advance prevention alone identifies the correct answer.

D’autres encore adds precautions; mesurerai bien encore adds the companion’s measurement after the dwarf’s. The published primary definition explicitly includes additional quantity, so augment that same identity with a contextual bank rather than duplicating encore mastery. The old stored bank tests still, and is preserved pending final reconciliation.

Peuvent encore avoir retains a possibility despite smaller size: still/nevertheless, not again and not a further comparative degree. Link the published continuation sense and author a context making that persistent possibility explicit. Legacy still mastery and the broad primary sense remain intact.

The colon introduces a sustained spoken address. Discours/silence/geste/voyage are masculine singular after son; connected words addressed to listeners select discours. This is not merely an isolated word or a grammatical exercise.

The humans cannot be seen by the giant unaided, hence invisibles. The existing invisible definition includes what cannot be seen or remains hidden; add this plural surface to that same meaning. Audibility and touchability are different senses, so the visual clue selects only invisibles.

Académie 1762 explicitly records main as figurative power, including God’s hand. Here the Creator’s productive agency is the contextual inference, not anatomy, a recognizable artist’s style or taking control of a service. Global main families were reviewed; author a fresh creative-power sense on the existing lemma. Main/tête/jambe/peau are feminine singular and fit la.

Faire naître is a causative make-come-into-existence construction. The existing naître sense explicitly covers beginning to exist or appearing; do not confuse the causative faire with naître’s own meaning. No new verb meaning is required.

L’abîme de l’infiniment petit metaphorically describes an immeasurable domain of smallness, not a reported physical pit. The abyss depth image is retained in all questions and explicitly marked figurative. Abîme/pré/pont/rivage are masculine singular after un; depth without a visible bottom selects abîme.

Je le remercie thanks the Creator for revealing knowledge. The published remercier gratitude sense and the earlier Chapter II same-lemma plan were checked; add this conjugated surface with its own three bands on that unchanged sense.

items.meaning: has; auxiliary forming a compound past
items.reviewNote: A precedes daigné, eu, mesuré, dit, découvert and disséqué. Even in il y a eu, a is the outer compound auxiliary while eu carries the existential lexical value. All global avoir senses were read. Link the explicit compound-auxiliary sense; the legacy a possession bank is preserved, never copied to this new surface/sense identity.

At 167 il y a introduces the existence of tiny animals. Global avoir plans already route the earlier a existential to sns_fr_avoir_existential; use that meaning. Its earlier Chapter IV middle context lacks il y, so author an intact construction here and record the old-bank repair dependency for final whole-work reconciliation, without silently editing it.

The giant credits the Creator with graciously consenting to reveal secrets. Daigner has no published or earlier family; the past participle and later conditional form share one lexical sense rather than separate tense meanings. All four participles fit il a followed immediately by me répondre; only daigné adds the explicitly described gracious or condescending consent.

Me découvrir des secrets makes information known to the giant. The global family’s uncover-material and find/learn-for-oneself senses do not express this recipient-directed disclosure. Académie 1762 révéler gives découvrir as disclose unknown secret knowledge. Prepare that meaning on the existing découvrir lemma and preserve discovery mastery.

The secrets had appeared inaccessible before the revelation. Global sembler senses were read; the explicit appearance definition covers the source. Only semblaient qualifies a perceived impression; devenir/rester assert change or continuation, and disparaître does not assert appearance.

The secrets’ inaccessibility is intellectual, not a physically impermeable wall or forest. No published or earlier impénétrable family exists. All alternatives are plural adjective predicates; inability to understand, not spelling agreement, selects the target.

Ne daignerait-on pas vous regarder concerns whether courtiers would condescend to notice the tiny humans. It shares daigné’s gracious/condescending consent meaning and the same planned lemma/sense; conditional inflection alone creates no sense. The target is the already authored bank in this exact package.

The giant offers protection to the humans. The published offrir definition explicitly covers presenting something for acceptance and is not limited to physical objects. Its reflexive treat-oneself sense is excluded; this first-person surface shares the offer sense.

The giant promises to safeguard the people. No published or earlier protection family exists. Protection/punition/menace/désertion are feminine singular and fit une; only support shielding someone from harm satisfies the middle clue.

Plus que jamais means more than ever, without negating the action. The earlier positive-ever planned sense already contrasts any possible occasion with negative never; this comparative context uses that same any-time value. Extend its bank to the comparative construction rather than create a third jamais sense or reuse the published never-only questions.

items.meaning: been; existed in there has been
items.reviewNote: In il y a eu quelqu’un, a is the outer compound auxiliary and eu is the participle of existential avoir. The legacy eu bank tests possession or experiencing an idea, so it cannot answer the source existential role. Prepare the explicit existential identity on lem_avoir with its own bank; all source words in il y a ___ remain intact.

Quelqu’un d’étonné is an astonished person hearing unexpected words, not someone shaken literally by thunder. The earlier étonnés/étonna plans target the published surprise sense; retain it, with a singular participial surface bank rather than a new adjective-only meaning.

The humans hear the giant’s spoken address. The published auditory sense and VI entendre-understand proposal were compared; choose auditory perception for these words coming from an unknown location. All four predicates share the plural past construction and differ by sense modality.

Elles resumes the words, not female people leaving. D’où elles partaient asks where the sound originated. The published leave/set-out sense and à partir de starting-point construction were read; this emitted-sound origin is distinguished under the existing partir lemma. The source provides origin evidence; the text does not identify the speaker yet.

The ship’s chaplain recites the prayers of exorcism. Aumônier/officier/arpenteur/ouvrier are masculine singular and all begin with a vowel, fitting unchanged l’. Only the clerical service role selects aumônier; elision cannot select it.

Récita names the aloud delivery of prayers, without inventing evidence that he read or memorized them. No existing or earlier réciter family exists. All four singular past predicates fit les as direct object; only recitation means saying the text aloud.

items.meaning: prayers; words addressed to a deity
items.reviewNote: These are the prayers in the exorcism rite, rather than secular requests for a favor. Prières/lettres/histoires/chansons are feminine plural and fit des; religious address alone selects the target. Source association with exorcisms is retained without asserting that the rite works.

items.meaning: exorcisms; rites intended to expel evil spirits
items.reviewNote: The chaplain recites the prayers belonging to exorcisms in response to the unexplained voice. This is the narrator’s rite label, not evidence of supernatural efficacy. Exorcismes/voyages/calculs/jugements are masculine plural after des; the expulsion rite alone selects exorcismes.

Académie 1762 distinguishes formal oath-taking from absolute jurer for swearing from emotion or bad habit. The source contrasts chaplain’s prayers, sailors’ curses and philosophers’ theories; cursing is the contextual inference. The global oath and discord senses were read and excluded; prepare this distinct sense on the existing jurer lemma.

The philosophers compose explanatory systems rather than build material objects or merely perform an unspecified activity. The earlier Chapter I fit composed-song plan already separates composition of an intellectual work from material fabrication. Reuse that planned composition meaning for theories with a new plural-form bank; do not create a theory-only faire sense.

The philosophers devise intellectual explanatory systems, not mechanical devices or information technology. Académie 1762 hypothèse explicitly equates assembled explanatory suppositions with a système. Systèmes/voyages/outils/édifices are masculine plural with des; explanatory ideas select systèmes.

Quelque système qu’ils fissent concedes whichever explanatory system they formed. It shares the newly authored plural systèmes explanatory theory sense and lemma; number alone is not a new sense. Système/voyage/outil/édifice are masculine singular and fit un; only explanatory ideas satisfy the clue.

Quelque système qu’ils fissent uses the concessive imperfect subjunctive of the same theoretical composition as firent des systèmes. The earlier composed-work sense is the identity target for both; mood and tense alone do not create a second sense. All four predicates take the direct-object explanation; formation alone selects fissent.

The dwarf’s voice is less thunderous and safer for the listeners than Micromégas’s. The published pleasing-to-the-feelings sense and its emotional banks were inspected; acoustic softness is distinguished under the same doux adjective lemma. All four feminine singular voice descriptions fit elle était, while weak gentle sound selects douce.

items.meaning: had; auxiliary in a compound past
items.reviewNote: Avaient été is the pluperfect of être, not the possession of an object. Global avoir compound auxiliaries and the old avaient possession bank were inspected. Link sns_fr_avoir_compound_auxiliary on lem_avoir and author the complete auxiliary context without overwriting or copying legacy possession progress.

items.meaning: have; auxiliary forming a past infinitive
items.reviewNote: Les avoir plaints has a direct object and the past infinitive avoir plus plaints: after having pitied them. Earlier Chapter V avoir auxiliary questions already target the published compound-auxiliary sense, but their source form was ai. Prepare the actual infinitive surface on that same sense; lexical avoir un esprit remains separate.
